desc: Retrieve List download URL from an export job to download List contents.

list_id.desc: ID of the List to export.

job_id.desc: The ID of the recently started job to export the List.

format.desc: Format the export was started with. Must match the `format` passed to `slackLists.download.start`. Defaults to `csv`.

include_threads.desc: Must match the `include_threads` passed to `slackLists.download.start`. The returned `download_url` carries this through so the served export matches what was generated. Only applies when `format` is `json`.

include_attachments.desc: Must match the `include_attachments` passed to `slackLists.download.start`. The returned `download_url` carries this through so the served export matches what was generated. Only applies when `format` is `json`.

status.desc: Current status of the export job.

download_url.desc: The URL at which to download the CSV.

permission_denied.desc: The bot does not have permission to perform this action.

unknown_method.desc: Feature not enabled for this team.

job_not_found.desc: Could not find an export job matching that ID.
